import json,sys,datetime,collections
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc); cut=now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=10)
rows=[]
for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines():
    try:r=json.loads(line)
    except:continue
    t=r.get('at')
    if not t: continue
    try:dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except:continue
    if dt>=cut: rows.append((dt,r))
# per-minute unique callers + process events
b=collections.defaultdict(lambda:{'callers':set(),'started':0,'read':0,'exit':0,'kill':0,'post_err':0})
proc={}
for dt,r in rows:
    minute=dt.replace(second=0,microsecond=0)
    cid=r.get('caller_id')
    if cid: b[minute]['callers'].add(cid)
    ev=r.get('event')
    if ev=='process_started': b[minute]['started']+=1
    elif ev=='process_read': b[minute]['read']+=1
    elif ev=='process_exit_observed': b[minute]['exit']+=1
    elif ev=='process_killed': b[minute]['kill']+=1
    if ev=='response_finish' and isinstance(r.get('status'),int) and r['status']>=400: b[minute]['post_err']+=1
    pid=r.get('process_id')
    if pid:
        rec=proc.setdefault(pid,{'caller':cid,'started':None,'exit':None,'last':dt,'pid':r.get('pid'),'cwd':r.get('cwd')})
        rec['last']=max(rec['last'],dt)
        rec['caller']=cid or rec['caller']; rec['pid']=r.get('pid') or rec['pid']; rec['cwd']=r.get('cwd') or rec['cwd']
        if ev=='process_started': rec['started']=dt
        if ev in ('process_exit_observed','process_killed'): rec['exit']=dt
print('LIVE_MCP_10MIN')
for m in sorted(b):
    x=b[m]; print(m.strftime('%H:%MZ'), 'callers',len(x['callers']),'started',x['started'],'reads',x['read'],'exits',x['exit'],'kills',x['kill'],'http_err',x['post_err'])
active=[]
for k,v in proc.items():
    if v['started'] and not v['exit']:
        active.append((v['last'],k,v))
print('UNEXITED_PROCESSES_SEEN=',len(active))
for last,k,v in sorted(active,reverse=True)[:30]:
    print(k,'caller='+str(v['caller']),'pid='+str(v['pid']),'age_s=%.1f'%((now-last).total_seconds()),'cwd='+str(v['cwd']))
